hold_text: Substance is observability (a read-only attention_watch probe, per-package refusal pings, a latency_s clamp), but the pings hook src/units/accounts/execute.py::log_rejection_to_journal and src/core/coordinator.py::_emit_execution_failure_ping (order-path modules the live trader loads) and src/runtime/desk_packet_wake.py (a runtime service module). Per the dispatch: touching those means Tier 2, so the manager merges and the VM needs a restart/deploy to observe the pings.
why: DESK-V1-ALERTS (V1 Thu-2, gaps G1/G10): probe desk_row_missing (packet with no decision row > 15 min), one ping per refused / rejected / expired claude_desk package, desk_wake_post_receipt latency_s clamped to >= 0. No change to what trades, sizing, risk or exits; a ping failure is swallowed.
